title: Partition of constraints by variable occurrence
statement: Let a constraint template on a set $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $P$ be a finite set of variables. Suppose a constraint instance on $P$ has a nonempty multiset of constraints and every variable in $P$ occurs in the scope of at least one constraint. For any variable $v\in P$, the multiset of constraints whose scopes contain $v$ plus the multiset of constraints whose scopes omit $v$ equals the full constraint multiset.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given
The constraint instance has a nonempty constraint multiset
Every variable in $P$ occurs in some constraint scope
